name: Pa pinh top
summary: Folded grilled fish. The Điện Biên culture desk says “pa” is fish and “pa pỉnh tộp” is the folded grill, and that Thái Đen cooks use a fish of 1–1.5 kg. Vietnam News repeats that weight. Vietnamnet says a bit over 1 kg and names carp, trôi, mè, and trắm. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. The culture desk published the method on 23 Mar 2020. Vietnam News repeated the weight on 28 Apr 2024. Vietnamnet, following Gia đình & Xã hội, described the fish on 8 Oct 2015.
culture: The culture desk quotes a Thái line, “cáy măn mọk má ha, báu to pa pỉnh tộp ma sú,” and glosses it as a young chicken brought over not matching this fish given as a gift. Vietnam News quotes Nguyễn Minh Phú, director of the culture department, naming the fish among the province’s specialities, and names chẩm chéo as a sauce beside it. The culture desk’s recipe does not use the words chẩm chéo.
taste: The culture desk says the cooked fish is sweet and fatty, hot from chilli and mắc khén, green from spring onion and herbs, and yellow at the skin. Vietnam News calls it savoury and hot from the chilli and mắc khén, and fragrant from the herbs. Both stay.
howToEat: The culture desk: choose 1–1.5 kg, split along the back, remove the guts, drain, rub toasted salt inside, and stuff with mắc khén, roasted fresh chilli pounded, spring onion, herbs, and coriander. Rest it, clamp it with bamboo, and grill it over charcoal. When it is golden it should still be whole.

Vietnam News: clean a 1–1.5 kg fish, stuff mắc khén, fresh minced chilli, green onions, herbs, and coriander, and cook it on a bamboo stick over charcoal until golden. That account does not print the back cut or the salt.
Vietnamnet: carp, trôi, mè, or trắm, a bit over 1 kg, split along the back, toasted salt, the same family of stuffing, folded in half, clamped with bamboo, and grilled over charcoal.
Eat it from the grill. A price and a stall hour are Check on arrival.
where: The Thái table in the basin. Vietnam News quotes the culture director on bản Phiêng Lơi, at the entrance to the city. No shop is named. A stall hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Pa pinh top in Dien Bien Phu — folded grilled fish
seoDescription: Thái folded fish, 1–1.5 kg on the culture desk and Vietnam News, a bit over 1 kg on Vietnamnet. Chẩm chéo is named only by Vietnam News. A price is Check on arrival.
